ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; do not flag the driver (arrival conditions were merely unmet, no mis-tap fraud per F6).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat contains only pickup/cancellation logistics (F9, F10) and the driver's statement (F12) is a no-show claim; no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation → safety_concern none, no escalation.

This is a driver-cancelled no-show claiming the fee, so it enters via NS-0 → NS-1. Checking NS-1's three cumulative requirements against a default >3 min (no no-show threshold is recorded in this case file):
(i) "I'm Here" tap: F6 shows the driver tapped at 21:29:45 — satisfied, and it is a driver_tap, not a platform auto-arrival (F5).
(ii) GPS at the pickup at tap: F6 places the driver 41 m from the pickup at that moment; the data-layer radius is 200 m → satisfied.
(iii) Continuous ≥3:01 waiting within 200 m after the tap until cancellation: F6 gives only 1 min 45 s within 200 m after the tap, and cancellation came at 21:31:30, 2 min 55 s after the 21:28:35 arrival (F5) and roughly 1 min 45 s after the tap (F4/F6). The total time within 200 m across the whole stop was 2 min 55 s (F2), also under 3:01. So (iii) fails.

Because a required element of NS-1 fails, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 rider cancellation fee does not stand and must be refunded in full (F4, F7). The driver's claim of "at least 5 minutes" (F12) is a statement contradicted by the GPS/timeline records (F2, F3, F5, F6), which take priority. The per-message reading confirms he only arrived 21:28:35–21:29:45 and cancelled at 21:31:30.

No flag_account: although the tap was at 200 m+... it was not — the tap distance (41 m, F6) is within range, so the fraud limb of NS-2 (tap while >200 m from pickup) is not triggered; NS-3 does not produce a flag. Driver profile (F17, 0 upheld) adds nothing. Amount = $6.61, to be issued as a voucher per NS-7.

Route-deviation clauses (RD-*) are not engaged: this is a no-show/cancellation dispute, no off-route segment facts were given.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's written statement (F12) says he waited at least 5 minutes for a no-show, but GPS/timeline records show arrival confirmation at 21:28:35, tap at 21:29:45 and cancellation at 21:31:30 — a maximum continuous wait within 200 m of 2 min 55 s (F2, F3, F5, F6), below the >3 min threshold NS-1(iii) requires. System records override statements.
